about: Albert Cohen is the founder of the Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C., located in Forest Hills, New York, where he focuses his practice on personal injury law and accident-related claims. He represents individuals who have been injured due to negligence, providing legal guidance through each stage of the claims process and advocating for fair compensation on their behalf.

Mr. Cohen’s practice covers a broad range of personal injury matters, including motor vehicle accidents, premises liability and other negligence-based claims. He works closely with clients to assess the circumstances of their cases, develop effective legal strategies and pursue favorable outcomes through negotiation or litigation when necessary. His approach emphasizes responsiveness, clear communication and a commitment to protecting his clients’ interests.

Mr. Cohen earned his Bachelor of Arts from Cleveland State University in 1995, graduating with departmental honors and earning recognition on the dean’s list. He later obtained his Juris Doctor from Pace University School of Law in 2002, graduating cum laude. His academic achievements reflect a strong foundation in legal analysis and advocacy.

Admitted to practice law in New York in 2002, Mr. Cohen maintains active involvement in professional organizations. He is a member of the New York State Bar Association and the New York State Trial Lawyers Association. He is also affiliated with the American Academy of Estate Planning Attorneys, reflecting a broader engagement with the legal community.

In recognition of his professional accomplishments, Mr. Cohen was named to the Million Dollar Advocates Forum in 2014, an honor associated with achieving significant case results. His inclusion in the Million Dollar Advocates Forum reflects his experience in handling cases that result in substantial recoveries for clients.
